title: Fireworks Complaints vs dBA Threshold
dataSources: Decoration timers (`holidaytimer:event`), birthday spending (`birthday:spend`), and fireworks noise events (`fireworks:noise`).
app: Seasonal household telemetry from decoration timers, birthday spending trackers, and fireworks noise sensors sent to Splunk HEC via Home Assistant, budget exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fireworks:noise
| search db_peak>=85
| stats count as noisy_windows avg(complaint_flag) as complaint_rate by zone_name
| sort 0 - noisy_windows
description: Ranks zoness by high-noise complaint risk.
value: Putting complaints beside high-dBA windows shows whether the measured noise is also socially disruptive.
implementation: Send high-noise complaint risk events to `index=personal` and keep `zone_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of high-noise complaint risk by zones.
grandmaExplanation: It turns which zoness stand out most for high-noise complaint risk.
